scope: Baseball-Reference war_daily team_ID to canonical org. `orgs` covers seasons 1969 to 2026 and keys on (team_id, season); it is the /franchise/ club bWAR line. `history` carries the map back to 1871, keyed on (team_id, lg, season), with every season before 1969 landing on one of the 30 franchises or on a named defunct club; it serves the Hall of Fame franchise credit (docs/HOF_FRANCHISE_ATTRIBUTION.md, owner answer 2026-09-25). The 2000-2026 standings join by StatsAPI team id (stable across relocations) and need no spine.

relocations.note: Oakland to West Sacramento (Sutter Health Park) for 2025; ATH is also the 1871-1875 Philadelphia Athletics code in the frame, outside this spine's window
Tampa Bay Devil Rays to Tampa Bay Rays
Anaheim Angels to Los Angeles Angels

not_in_scope: the cap a Hall of Fame plaque shows (the credit is by playing WAR, not by plaque)

history.key: (team_id, lg, season); lg NA is the National Association, which war_daily carries as a null lg_ID
history.basis: lineage follows the Baseball-Reference and Lahman franchise grouping (a current franchise starts at its club's NL 1876, AA 1882 or AL 1901 entry; National Association clubs are clubs of their own). Every other season before 1969 is a named defunct club: one team code, split at a league-family change and, for nineteenth-century majors, at a missing season, then joined by the named merges. Written by tools/franchise_spine_history.py from the war_daily parquets.
